scripts.android: FITIN_PLATFORM=android node scripts/with-environment.mjs development expo run:android
scripts.ios: FITIN_PLATFORM=ios node scripts/with-environment.mjs development expo run:ios
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run harness:check
scripts.build:web: node scripts/with-environment.mjs development expo export --platform web
scripts.build:web:production: node scripts/with-environment.mjs production expo export --platform web
scripts.prebuild:ios: FITIN_PLATFORM=ios node scripts/with-environment.mjs development npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install
scripts.prebuild:ios:personal: FITIN_PERSONAL_TEAM=1 FITIN_PLATFORM=ios node scripts/with-environment.mjs development npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install
